name: nginx-multisite
description: Top-level Chef cookbook that orchestrates the full server provisioning sequence, chaining four sub-recipes (security, nginx, ssl, sites) in order. Targets Ubuntu ≥ 18.04 and CentOS ≥ 7.0 with a single external dependency on the cyberark-conjur cookbook.

name: nginx-multisite::nginx
description: Installs the nginx package, deploys global nginx.conf and a security.conf drop-in from ERB templates, creates per-site document-root directories, copies static index.html files for each vhost, and manages the nginx service.

name: nginx-multisite::ssl
description: Installs openssl and ca-certificates, provisions certificate and private-key directories with strict permissions, and generates self-signed RSA-2048 certificates for every SSL-enabled vhost. Retrieves the private-key passphrase from CyberArk Conjur at converge time.

name: nginx-multisite::sites
description: Iterates over configured vhosts to render per-vhost Nginx server-block configs from a template into sites-available and creates symlinks in sites-enabled. Enforces HTTP→HTTPS redirect, TLS 1.2/1.3, HSTS, and a full set of security response headers.

name: nginx-multisite::security
description: Installs fail2ban and ufw, deploys jail.local, configures UFW with default-deny rules, writes kernel hardening parameters to sysctl.d, and conditionally hardens sshd_config. Also invokes four custom resources: ada_ada, fetch_token, fetch_and_parse_token, my_format, and secret_setting.

name: ada_ada
description: A custom Chef resource that performs regex-based find-and-replace (or append) on arbitrary text configuration files, creating a timestamped backup before modifying. Used to patch sshd_config directives such as PermitRootLogin and PasswordAuthentication.

name: fetch_token
description: A custom Chef resource that POSTs a JSON body with client_id and client_secret to an OAuth2 token endpoint and stores the returned access_token in node.run_state. Contains a hardcoded client_secret value in its caller, representing a critical security finding.

name: fetch_and_parse_token
description: A custom Chef resource that performs an HTTP GET against a configurable URL and extracts a value from the response body using a regex capture group, storing the result in node.run_state. The regex pattern and endpoint appear to be placeholders requiring clarification before migration.

name: my_format
description: A custom Chef resource that manages entries in a proprietary !key=value configuration format for an internal application at /etc/company/app.conf, supporting upsert and remove actions while preserving comment lines. Has no direct standard Ansible module equivalent.

name: secret_setting
description: A custom Chef resource that retrieves named secrets from an internal secrets platform via the proprietary Ruby gem company_internal_lib, storing the retrieved value in node.run_state. Depends on undocumented internal infrastructure with no public documentation.
